text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Tender for RFT-56-Roof Replacement & Skylight Repairs at Caribou Café, Africa Restaurant, Hyena, Hippo project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the award of Request for Tender RFT-56 - Roof Replacement and Skylight Repair at Caribou Cafe, Africa Restaurant, Hyena Hippo Buildings to Provincial Industrial Roofing and Sheet Metal Co Ltd. in the amount of $737,050.00, excluding applicable taxes.
